"WITH commits AS (
  SELECT
    commit_hash,
    author_name,
    CAST(author_date AS DATE) AS commit_date,
    lower(subject) AS subject
  FROM git_commits
)
SELECT
  c.commit_date,
  c.author_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.commit_hash) AS commits,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_noise THEN 0 ELSE f.lines_added END) AS real_lines_added,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_noise THEN 0 ELSE f.lines_deleted END) AS real_lines_deleted
FROM commits c
JOIN git_commit_files f ON f.commit_hash = c.commit_hash
GROUP BY c.commit_date, c.author_name
ORDER BY c.commit_date"
